slice: ClickHouse outbox capped exponential retry backoff
implementation: Failed ClickHouse outbox deliveries now use a 60-second exponential retry base, doubled by persisted attempt count and capped at one hour.
ClickHouse client setup failures use the same delay schedule as per-row insertion failures.
Successful deliveries retain their existing availability timestamp, lease fencing and stable insertion deduplication token; the maximum attempt count remains eight.

isolation.postgresql: mocked connection only; no database contacted
isolation.clickhouse: mocked client and delivery boundaries; no service contacted

limitations: The schedule and SQL binding are covered by unit/source checks; live PostgreSQL and ClickHouse outage behavior remains unverified.
No candidate rollout, MAN-CAP acceptance, or production configuration changed.
